params.title: Why deciding every day ends good habits

caption.instagram:
Why you never do the thing you planned for tonight (and how to fix it).

Why we stop doing things we know are good for us, reason #14: the day goes first. Every hour adds something: an email, a favour, being tired. By 9 PM your goal is last in line and the easiest thing to drop.

The fix: the first 10 minutes after you wake up, before you touch your phone.
- Learning Spanish: 10 minutes saying the sentences you actually use
- Writing a book: 100 words before you open a single message

10 minutes at 7 beats an hour planned for 9, because 7 actually happens.
